result.title: Europe’s AI Future With Judith Dada | Pub Conversations
result.description:
What does Europe need to get right about AI?

Langdock Co-CEO Judith Dada joins NVIDIA’s Chris Alexiuk to talk about Europe’s AI future, from building computing infrastructure to bringing AI’s benefits to everyday life.

They discuss her move from venture capital to Langdock, the scenario she co-wrote in Europe 2031, and why human dignity matters as AI becomes more capable.
